decisions.bandwidth_flag: retired - not discriminative for this content, see notes.bandwidth; sample_rate from ffprobe is the correct signal for under-sampling, not content rolloff

notes.bandwidth: The median 0.95-energy roll-off of speech sits at roughly 3-6 kHz regardless of the true codec cutoff, so the <10000 Hz rule flagged every file (3150/3150) and is not discriminative. Raw rolloff_median_hz values are carried over from Task 6 and committed so a better-calibrated threshold can be chosen later.
notes.policy: Report-only. No source mp3 was modified, trimmed, re-encoded or gain-adjusted; loudness_outlier is informational and is not corrected here.
